description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Caitlyn''' fires a piercing shot in the target direction that deals physical damage to the first enemy it passes through, after which it expands in width but deals only 60% damage to enemies it hits thereafter.
description.text: Active: Caitlyn fires a piercing shot in the target direction that deals physical damage to the first enemy it passes through, after which it expands in width but deals only 60% damage to enemies it hits thereafter.

description2.raw: Enemies [[File:True Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight#True_sight|An icon representing the keyword True sight]] [[:Sight#True_sight|revealed]] by ''[[File:Caitlyn Yordle Snap Trap.png|20xpx|border|link=Caitlyn#Yordle Snap Trap|An icon for Caitlyn's ability Yordle Snap Trap]] [[Caitlyn#Yordle Snap Trap|Yordle Snap Trap]]'' always take [[File:Successfully enhanced damage physical icon.png|20px|link=Damage#Successful_ability_casts]] full damage from ''Piltover Peacemaker''.
description2.text: Enemies revealed by Yordle Snap Trap always take full damage from Piltover Peacemaker.

notes.raw: * Upon ''Piltover Peacemaker'' dealing damage to an enemy, '''Caitlyn's''' [[attack timer]] is forcibly [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|reset]].(bug) * Enemies hit while protected by a [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]] will still be considered a target for calculating damage for subsequent hits. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.
notes.text:
Upon Piltover Peacemaker dealing damage to an enemy, Caitlyn's attack timer is forcibly reset.(bug)
Enemies hit while protected by a spell shield will still be considered a target for calculating damage for subsequent hits.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.
